description: Export artboards as GIF or PNG-8 with a reduced colour table, one per artboard (File > Export > Save for Web (Legacy)): colours, reduction, dither, transparency, matte, web snap, lossy GIF, interlacing, scale, HTML

artboards.description: Artboards to export, 1-based like Illustrator: "1", "1-3,5". Default all

clipToArtboard.description: Crop each image to its artboard. False writes one image of all the artwork. Default true

colors.description: Colours in the colour table. Default 128

matteColor.description: Blend edges (and, with transparent false, the background) against #RRGGBB, or "none". Default white

prefix.description: File name prefix. Default the document name

reduction.description: Colour reduction: perceptual, selective (default), adaptive or web

saveAsHtml.description: Also write an HTML page showing each image. Default false

verticalScale.description: Vertical percent when different from scale

webSnap.description: Percent tolerance for shifting colours to the web palette. Default 0

name: export_web_image
title: Export Web Image
